source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: Extension spaces store the button ID under tabInfo._ext.extensionSpaces.id. A monitor named extensionSpaces returns that namespace when a tab is persisted and restores it when tabmail dispatches saved ext data. This is a static persistence chain. Open-tab session saving and close undo have different lifetimes: closeTab can serialize the tab into recentlyClosedTabs before removing the live tab. The changed tests use the shared accessor but add no restart assertion. No restart or deletion guarantee was tested.
title: Space tab identity survives through a named persistence monitor
